envelope.description: Lifecycle back-fill and the migrated log entries

body.title: Lifecycle back-fill and the migrated log entries
body.summary: Add src/workflow/convert/backfill.ts: from a raw legacy head compute meta.envelope and meta.lifecycle (status, approval, review bound to the head's current revision, stale), the contentHash of the converted content, the stamp entries (-approve, -reject, -mark-stale), the review entry from t2 and the revision-bearing migrated-<artifact id> entry (operation create when the artifact has no log, update otherwise; actor insrc:migration; the stamps' original times). Test src/workflow/convert/__tests__/convert-lifecycle-backfill.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: Status follows the later of the approval and rejection stamps and both stamp entries keep their original times
A review older than the head's revision is not bound to it and the review entry still records the report
The revision-bearing entry carries the head's meta.revision and the contentHash of the converted content

tests.name: convert-lifecycle-backfill.test.ts: the lifecycle and the migrated entries are computed from the legacy fields
